name: WFCRL
description: A multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmark for wind farm control that measures cooperative control performance, power maximization, and robustness in simulated farm environments.
evaluation_method: average_episode_reward (or normalized farm power output over episodes)
general_score_metric: average episode reward / normalized power output (mean power or percent improvement over baseline)
reputation: A focused academic benchmark used in wind-farm control research; recognized in the specialized community but not widely adopted outside that niche.
notes: Simulation-based multi-agent RL benchmark; non-LLM. Typical caveats include sim-to-real gap, sensitivity to environment and wake modeling, and limited standardized real-world validation.
